description: Lets Blasius send your sales team's email from a dedicated subdomain (for example ventas.yourcompany.com) with SPF and DKIM, and receive replies on it. Your main domain, website and existing mailboxes are not changed.
variableDescription: %dkimkey%: DKIM public key issued for the subdomain (without the p= prefix); %region%: sending region of the subdomain (for example us-east-1); %recepcion%: inbound mail host label issued for the subdomain (receive or receive-<region>). Applied with host=<subdomain>, so every record lands under that subdomain.
